Leyland Retail 10Ltr Magnolia Matt Emulsion Paint delivers a high-quality, durable finish for interior walls and ceilings. This water-based paint offers excellent opacity, ensuring effective coverage and a smooth matt appearance. Its quick-drying formula allows it to be touch-dry in 2-4 hours and recoatable in 2-4 hours, speeding up project completion for busy tradespeople. Suitable for application by brush, roller, or spray, this emulsion paint is ideal for refreshing residential or commercial interiors, providing a consistent magnolia hue throughout. Each 10-litre plastic bucket covers approximately 13 square metres per litre.
